svg.aria-label: An example graph: goal, worker, parallel independent acceptance and code reviews, adversarial end-to-end test, PR, CI, then merge. Both reviewers must approve before testing and delivery. A failed review, test or CI run returns through repair, implementation and review before delivery is retried. This illustrative animation is not a recorded run. Reviews, end-to-end tests and CI each fail before repairs pass. Merge is the final step; post-merge checks are outside this example.
